title: [v0.92.2][CF-REMEDIATE] Generate a bounded remediation plan from review findings
review_findings: Canonical exact-head review of b1060f8c61904e2e0452048fda46d23513ad1a02 by fresh-session:83a5713c-fba0-4ae4-9a34-8334aca3f725 returned FAIL: P1 the public production `plan(&ReviewSynthesis)` API still accepted bare synthesis outside the file/CLI gate; P1 the installed reader did not require its caller-supplied filename to match manifest.remediation_plan_ref, allowing an aliased plan artifact; P2 SRP/SOR consequently overstated complete binding and used inaccurate byte-equivalent wording.
review_dispositions: All findings accepted and remediated. The public planner now requires both ReviewSynthesis and ReviewRecord and independently recomputes canonical completed synthesis before planning, so no public bare-synthesis API remains. The reader requires its input filename to equal manifest.remediation_plan_ref and a focused alias negative proves rejection. All planner algorithm tests now derive synthesis from valid completed review records instead of hand-built ReviewSynthesis objects. Lifecycle wording now claims structurally canonical, digest-bound replanning rather than byte equivalence.
review_notes: The remediation changed production API and tests after the failed review. A different canonical fresh-session reviewer must inspect the new immutable commit. No #894/#895 implementation scope is included.
